title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: The bracketed condition 'telle que Ã' et telle que' is incomplete. Presumably it should read 'telle que Ã' soit stable par ∂', i.e. a union of edges.

No stability condition is imposed. Dropping marked points (I' a proper subset of I ⊔ J̃) or keeping only some components can produce an unstable pointed curve, e.g. a genus-0 component with fewer than 3 special points. One would then need stabilisation (contraction), or else work with non-stable 'special curves'. This is not addressed here, though it may be handled elsewhere in the notes.

The geometric phrasing 'replacing X' by a neighbourhood containing A' and I'' is only heuristic. For nodes outside A' whose half-edges lie in S' but are not kept in I', the precise meaning (normalise and forget the point) needs care, as does the pinning datum.

ideas.what: Category of ν-graphs whose morphisms ('simplification morphisms', defined on the next page) are subgraph inclusions plus injective relabelling of markings into markings or cut half-edges.

deep.surprise_reason: Careful but standard bookkeeping of dual graphs of stable curves (subgraphs, cutting nodes, vertex components). It anticipates later graph-category formalisms for M̄_{g,n} but contains nothing a specialist would find new.
